name: gizza-ai/blur-image
summary: Apply a Gaussian blur of adjustable radius to an image.

tool.description: Apply a Gaussian blur of adjustable radius to an entire image. radius is the blur strength in pixels (Gaussian standard deviation; default 5.0, higher = blurrier; 2-10 is typical). Returns a PNG. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

radius.description: Gaussian blur radius in pixels (standard deviation; default 5.0). Higher blurs more; 2-10 is typical, 20+ is a heavy soft wash.
